We have more than one generator so we are using superposition to calculate voltages/currents.
Names starting with RGenZero refer to very small resistances, used during superposition.
We assume that the internal resistance of VM1 is RVM1=1GOhm
We assume that the internal resistance of IS1 is RIS1=1GOhm
###Processing generator VS1
First we calculate the total resistance between the generator nodes (VS1)
IS1 and R3 connected in series so Rc0=RIS1+R3=1GOhm+1kOhm=1GOhm
R2 and Rc0 connected in parallel so Rb0=R2*Rc0/(R2+Rc0)=1kOhm*1GOhm/(1kOhm+1GOhm)=1000Ohm
Rb0 and R1 connected in series so Ra0=Rb0+R1=1000Ohm+1kOhm=2kOhm
The total resistance is Ra0 = 2kOhm
Now we calculate the voltage on VM1
We know that the voltage between VS1 nodes is 5 Volt.

All current generators have been replaced with an open circuit.
